name: mojo-format-non-blocking
description: When Mojo 0.26.1 reports '_python_symbols' object has no attribute 'comptime_assert_stmt', use this skill. When formatter defects block CI or several pull requests need formatting fixes, use this skill. Make mojo-format an advisory CI step. Use SKIP=mojo-format and continue-on-error. Apply the CI formatting diff manually. Generated prose must follow ASD-STE100.
